hero.oneLiner: The deck positions Panache Digilife as "one of India's leading ESDM players", a Design-led Manufacturing (DLM) and Contract-led Manufacturing (CLM) company offering end-to-end ODM product development and manufacturing from a 50,000+ sq. ft. facility near Mumbai, riding Make in India and China+1 tailwinds.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Described as a "Design-led Manufacturing (DLM) and Contract-led Manufacturing (CLM) company providing end-to-end product development and manufacturing", covering "product design and engineering to manufacturing, testing, deployment and after-sales services".
- Claims involvement in "the entire ODM value chain right from product ideation, designing, prototype, manufacturing to after sales services", with the ODM chain listed as ideation, industrial design, prototype, production, quality check & assurance, packaging & logistics, after-sales support.
- Company-at-a-glance markers: "25+ YEARS EXPERIENCE", "150+ CUSTOMERS SERVED", "15+ COUNTRIES EXPORTED", "140+ ECOSYSTEM PARTNERS", "50,000+ SQ FT FACILITY".
- Positions on structural tailwinds: "leveraging the structural tailwinds of Make in India and the global China+1 strategy to establish India as a competitive hub for technology-led manufacturing", partnering with global technology companies and integrating their technologies with its own design, engineering, manufacturing and supply-chain capabilities.
- Self-described evolution "from manufacturing India's smallest PCs to developing next-generation AI servers, AI laptops and intelligent edge computing solutions".

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- Balance sheet deleveraging shown as Net Debt/Equity 0.98 (FY24), 0.29 (FY25), 0.21 (FY26) and Net Debt/Op. EBITDA 1.82 (FY25) to 0.81 (FY26); the ratio does not include Non-Controlling Interest.
- Net Worth moved from ₹6,589 lakhs (31-Mar-25) to ₹10,558 lakhs (31-Mar-26); Total Borrowings ₹2,041 to ₹2,472 lakhs; Cash & Cash Equivalents ₹105 to ₹272 lakhs; Net Debt ₹1,936 to ₹2,200 lakhs.
- Returns cited as ROE 14.1% (FY25) to 18.9% (FY26) and ROCE 13.6% (FY25) to 25.6% (FY26); the deck's FY24 comparatives are ROCE 12.7% and ROE 1.7%. Capital Employed is defined as "the sum of Total Equity and Total Debt".
- "Robust Financials" is listed as an investment highlight — "A strong financial foundation enabling sustainable growth and strategic investments"; management states it will keep "scaling the business responsibly, improving operating efficiencies".

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Listing status] The journey slide records both "Successfully completed IPO and got listed on the NSE SME platform" and "Shifted from SME to Main Board, enhancing investor participation and market visibility". The slide's period headings (2007, 2007-2012, 2013-2016, 2017-18, 2024-2026, 2023-2024, 2021-2022, 2020) are out of order in the extraction, so no milestone can be tied to a specific year.
- [Corporate structure] The journey slide states the Company "Consolidated frontend & customer service operations with AIR Digilife Private Limited"; the deck gives no consideration, date or ownership detail, and the year binding is lost in the same scrambled timeline.
- [Shareholding] As on 30th June 2026: Promoter & Promoter Group 54.05%, Resident Individuals 33.93%, Bodies Corporate 9.06%, NRIs 0.33%, Others 2.63%; free-float 45.95%, shares outstanding 1,60,14,000, Market Cap ₹69,220.52 lakhs and free-float market cap ₹31,806.90 lakhs.
- [Origins] Incorporated as "Vardhaman Technology Private Limited" in 2007, entering as a white-box desktop assembler.
- [Leadership] Promoter-led management: Mr. Amit Rambhia (Managing Director, 22+ years), Mr. Nikit Rambhia (Joint Managing Director, 20+ years), Mr. Nitesh Savla (CFO & Whole Time Director, 18+ years), with functional GMs in factory/operations (35+ years), automation (28+ years), key accounts (29+ years) and R&D (17+ years).
